questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert you to road conditions ahead. Speed advisory plaques below these signs tell you the safe speed to drive through the upcoming curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white rectangles with black markings. You must follow the rules on these signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings prepare you for road conditions ahead. This sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to make room for merging vehicles safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a roundabout is coming. Enter it slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors, road maintenance equipment, and horse-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that the road has multiple curves coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep or long downgrade or hill is ahead. It may have sharp curves as well.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs indicate you are approaching a school zone or school crossing. When you see these signs, stay alert and prepare to stop for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you the divided highway is about to end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare drivers for road hazards and are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks like an orange triangle during the day and a red hollow triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a bright yellow-green background. These signs warn about upcoming road conditions, including curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you to keep right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A solid green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: The five-sided sign means you are near a school. Be alert and stop if children are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a lane reserved only for left-turning vehicles. Do not use it for passing or driving straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before moving forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: The shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If your wheel drifts onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control. Instead, ease back onto the road carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is unsafe to enter this road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you that an intersection is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is ahead. Check your brakes before you go down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you of work areas ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through the construction zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign means traffic will merge in from the right. Be prepared to let them in safely.
